item.title: BLTFO!
item.description: Read BLTFO! The table of the intimidating bouncers starts to stand up, but before they have a chance to intervene, my five-foot-tall, sixty-five-year-old Greek boss (who is a grandmother) runs out from behind the register, shouting at him in Greek/English. Read BLTFO!

item.title: Hopefully, They Never Use DoorDash
item.description: Read Hopefully, They Never Use DoorDash Me: "Normally, they leave the item outside the front door if you're not home." Customer: *Rolling his eyes.* "Well, I don’t use my front door. I go through my garage, so they shouldn’t be delivering anything there!" Me: "But… but you did check your front door, right?" Read Hopefully, They Never Use DoorDash

item.title: It’s A Frame Job!
item.description: Read It’s A Frame Job! I used to work for a cheap custom frame company that could custom-frame your poster in about five minutes, if you selected one of our in-stock frames. We called ourselves the McDonald’s of framing. Our manager was the most irresponsible, narcissistic personality I’ve ever met, and the source of so many “can you believe it?” […] Read It’s A Frame Job!

item.title: Hot Pockets
item.description: Read Hot Pockets There was this one man who would come in, order a two-piece quarter pack, and then claim we forgot his chicken. When we turned around to fetch his drink at the end of the order, he would open the box, take out the chicken pieces, and hide them in his pockets. Hot chicken. Right in his pockets. Read Hot Pockets
